Here are presentations given by me or other lab members since 2020. Slides and posters are made available whenever permitted by collaborators, publishers, and funding agencies.

Remember that presentations are often *snapshots* of work in progress or work nearly complete. So, conclusions presented in the slides and posters below may not represent the final conclusions included in theses or manuscripts.
